name: Escalation'95 Onee-sama tte Yonde Ii Desu ka?
original_name: エスカレーション'95 お姉さまって呼んでいいですか?
source:
Escalation '95 doesn't have a particularly elaborate story: the protagonist is a female student named Naomi, who attends the Catholic St. Azarea high school. At the beginning of the year, new students enter the school, and Naomi's task is to show them around and help them - which she does in a very particular fashion...

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/escalation-95-oneesama-tte-yonde-ii-desu-ka]Mobygames[/url]]
translation:
《Escalation '95》没有特别精心设计的故事：主人公是一个名叫直美的女学生，就读于天主教圣阿扎利亚高中。新学年开始，新学生入学，直美的任务是带她们参观并帮助她们——她以一种非常特别的方式做到了这一点……

[来自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/escalation-95-oneesama-tte-yonde-ii-desu-ka]Mobygames[/url]]
